title: Unprecedently high dissolution and depolymerization of hard-to-dissolve polyurethane in deep eutectic solvents under low-energy white light
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,952-961
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00436E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Harmandeep Kaur, Rajwinder Kaur, Muskan, Manpreet Singh, Ravi Dutt, Kanica Sharma, Harjinder Singh, Kuldeep Singh, Arvind Kumar, Gurbir Singh, Tejwant Singh Kang
Metal salt-based DES dissolves polyurethane with a remarkable 70% yield and promotes depolymerization under mild, sustainable conditions. The Lewis-acidic nature of ZnCl2 plays a key role in cleaving otherwise hard-to-break polyurethane bonds.
